source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently test the assigned karst surface subsurface drainage concept in one complex photorealistic environmental scene, using the supplied portrait only as a general adult appearance reference while keeping the landform and connected water-routing evidence primary and unobstructed.
subject: A broad karst plateau showing a sinking surface stream and lower-slope resurgence, plus one adult documentary landscape photographer used as an appearance-reference carrier.
setting: A wet limestone plateau and closed basin viewed from a low ridge immediately after monsoon rain, with a lower cave spring in the same continuous landscape.
event: The photographer places paired red flow markers beside the point where runoff sinks into limestone while the lower resurgence visibly discharges.
visual_priorities: The surface-to-subsurface drainage chain reads as the main subject at thumbnail and native scale.
The reference-guided adult remains facially readable without blocking any karst evidence.
baseline_prompt_en: Create one photorealistic 35 mm deep-focus environmental photograph from a low ridge after clearing monsoon rain. The principal subject is a broad karst plateau whose surface water visibly drains underground and returns as a spring. Show pale exposed limestone etched by solution grooves, a closed bowl-shaped depression collecting runoff, and a continuous rain-fed stream descending across the basin into a clearly visible swallow opening; on the lower slope, blue-green water must visibly issue from a separate dark limestone cave mouth as a vigorous resurgence pool. Place one unmistakably adult documentary landscape photographer with the reference portrait's general facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair, and natural facial texture in the lower-left quarter, clearly visible yet no larger than one fifth of the frame, placing two small red flow markers beside the exact point where a rain-fed stream sinks into a limestone opening. Keep every drainage feature unobstructed and legible together. Use wet charcoal rock, moss green, turquoise water, distant mist, foreground runoff, oblique late-afternoon sunlight, realistic scale, continuous terrain, and crisp geological depth.
